title: Thick books
statementMd:
List books with more than 600 pages, with their page counts.

Expected columns: `title`, `pages`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, pages FROM books WHERE pages > 600;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
